repairs: On-demand inspection of the complete direct-measurement artifact; no automatic archive fetch.
Strict content-addressed namespace, typed clocks, coverage, length and SHA-256 checks before rendering.
Real shared inspector exposes every field and row with pagination and exact-path search. Missing values and decimal zero remain distinct.
Corrupt artifacts clear old rows. Source replacement aborts pending requests and blocks late repaint.
Source capture/replay claims remain separate from historical availability, forecast and portfolio qualification.
Responsive controls and vertically stacked mobile decision context. Manifest and complete JSON remain directly inspectable.

browser.scope: Isolated exact HTML/CSS, page renderer, evidence component and real shared inspector, with synthetic sources. Other site addons removed; CSP blocks external fetches. No live engine or consumer packet read.

limitations: The first ordinary native original-source publication remains pending its original schedule.
Browser byte integrity is not independent provider replay or validation of legacy heuristics, forecasts or sizing.
